steps.content:
You can buy from either seller. The two listings are identical on every point I could see:

| | Ottervale Audio (a) | Brackmoor Sound (b) |
|---|---|---|
| Product | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 | Quellwyn Stillwave H2 |
| Price | $129.00 | $129.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Stock | In stock | In stock |
| Rating | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) | 4.3/5 (210 reviews) |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Box contents and specs | Same | Same |

Nothing in the listings gives a reason to prefer one seller. Some things could still matter, and the pages don't show them:
- **Seller reputation:** The 210 reviews may be for the product overall, not for each seller. I couldn't see any seller-specific ratings.
- **Who honors the warranty:** The pages don't say whether the seller or the manufacturer handles warranty claims.
- **Authenticity:** The pages don't say whether either seller is an authorized Quellwyn reseller.

If you want a tiebreaker, look up each seller's reputation on an independent site. Check whether either one is listed as an authorized retailer on Quellwyn's website. If both check out the same, pick either one.
